snippet.title: Mimic | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Mimic is a new online social-deduction game inspired by Among Us, Secret Hitler, and Alien Isolation that turns the asymmetrical multiplayer horror genre on its head, capturing the fear, vulnerability, and atmosphere of classic single-player horror experiences in a role-based multiplayer setting. Players must escape the claustrophobic, crumbling corridors of the Icarus spacecraft while rooting out who amongst them is secretly a mimic — a malicious alien creature that can disguise itself as a fellow human survivor. Players will solve various objectives to create their escape route, survive against not one but two sinister threats pursuing them, and, as the terrifying titular Mimic, hunt from the shadows — and beneath the flesh of a friend. 
"
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
